purpose: Combined candidate selected for current-source qualification; final recommendation depends on all recorded guards and comparisons.
cover_policy: No forced GC, reclaim or freezing; ordinary covered pause plus the JVM trim interval.

selection.headers: Standing post-G1 heap minimum 17-23 MiB lower in both pairs, active frames clean.
selection.arena_cap: Both pairs saved 182-185 MiB settled and 248-295 MiB post-flight with no standing/flight frames over 17 ms.
selection.native_interval: Both pairs saved 170-206 MiB settled and 184-283 MiB post-flight. One isolated 18.5 ms flight frame makes combined frame qualification necessary.
selection.non_additive: Arena and interval savings overlap; no sum of isolated savings is claimed.
selection.excluded: String dedup, LWJGL system allocation, worker limits and FerriteCore lacked consistent additional benefit; forced covered GC exceeded 50 ms, and both frozen returns failed.
